title: go on that solo trip
description:
This solo travel vlog is one of the highlights of my life! California road trip starting in LA, up through Santa Barbara, San Luis Obispo (Madonna Inn), Big Sur, Carmel by the Sea and San Francisco. Swimming, hiking, adventure, exploring beaches and mountains, coastal drives, restaurants, great food and an NFL game plus a surprise at the end! Enjoy!! :))
